judged_text: The rewritten update action's primary path is left untested: the only .update spec covers ignoring name changes on automatic groups, and the deleted "is able to update group members" spec was never replaced. A regression in the new top-level-param update handling — renaming a non-automatic group, assigning alias_level, or the render_json_error path — breaks every admin group edit and ships green because no spec exercises it; the alias_level drop in create is exactly the class of bug this gap lets through.

adjudication.rationale: Diff rewrites `Admin::GroupsController#update` to accept top-level params (`alias_level`, `visible`, `name`) and to skip renames for automatic groups (new `update` method). The spec changes only add one `.update` test: "ignore name change on automatic group"; the prior test that exercised updating a normal group (including membership via params) was removed and not replaced with coverage for the new primary non-automatic update path (renaming, alias_level assignment, and the failure/render_json_error branch). This is a concrete, diff-grounded testing gap around newly changed behavior rather than a demonstrable runtime bug in the diff itself.
